sources.name: FastF1
sources.role: Primary reproducible F1 session, lap, telemetry and weather ingestion
sources.coverage_note: Detailed timing/telemetry is strongest from 2018 onward
sources.local_policy: Cache locally/Google Drive; do not commit raw data

sources.name: OpenF1
sources.role: Historical F1 API and future application data source
sources.coverage_note: Historical data from 2023 onward is available without authentication
sources.local_policy: Store fetched historical JSON outside git

sources.name: TracingInsights 2026
sources.role: Public telemetry archive and 2026 regulation-domain-shift test set
sources.coverage_note: Telemetry, lap timing, weather, race control, corners
sources.local_policy: Prefer sparse/targeted download; verify license/terms before redistribution

sources.name: F1 Corner Telemetry 2024-2025
sources.role: Phase 2 corner encoder and masked-patch self-supervised pretraining
sources.local_policy: Large data; stream/sample first, full download only in large research mode

sources.name: F1 StratLab Strategy Dataset
sources.local_policy: Optional benchmark data, not required for MVP

sources.name: IMSA Hugging Face Dataset
sources.coverage_note: Laps, sectors, stints, classes, pits and weather
sources.local_policy: Do not mix into F1 MVP; separate adapter and evaluation
